1-5.translation: 放棄了後餐的乞食，放下缽與法衣，洗淨雙足，在鋪設好的座位上結跏趺坐，挺直身體，將正念繫念在前而安坐。

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཟས་ཕྱི་མའི་བསོད་སྙོམས་སྤངས་ནས; Chone Drakpa Shedrub 1-6 glosses it as ཟས་ཕྱི་མ་ཕྱི་དྲོའི་བསོད་སྙོམས་ཟ་བ་སྤངས་ནས (giving up eating afternoon alms). '後餐' can be misread as a second/next meal rather than the post-meal (afternoon) alms the Buddha refrains from.
issues.fix: 捨棄了午後（後食）的乞食

2-3.translation: 世尊！如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者、佛，以何等最勝之利益，利益諸菩薩摩訶薩；如來以何等最勝之付囑，付囑諸菩薩摩訶薩。世尊，這真是稀有！善逝，這真是稀有！

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས is one epithet (locked: 正等覺者, with སངས་རྒྱས contained within it); the Tibetan list is only Tathāgata, arhat, perfectly complete Buddha (Sanskrit tathāgatena arhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena). The enumeration 正等覺者、佛 creates a fourth epithet.

3-7.translation: 真實步入菩薩乘者應當如何安住、應當如何修行、應當如何降伏其心，我將為你解說。

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཡང་དག་པར་བཞུགས་པ (Skt. samprasthita) uses ཡང་དག་པར 'correctly/properly', not 'truly/really'. 真實 reads as 'genuinely' (a claim about authenticity), whereas the Tibetan describes proper entry into the bodhisattva vehicle; english_academic has 'correctly entered'.

4-1.translation: 須菩提！於此真實步入菩薩乘者，應作是念：『無論多少眾生被攝於眾生之類中——或卵生，或胎生，或濕生，或化生，或有色，或無色，或有想，或無想，或非有想非無想，無論多少在眾生界中被假名施設為眾生者，我皆令彼等一切於蘊無餘涅槃界中般涅槃。』

issues.evidence: Tibetan བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་ཐེག་པ་ལ་ཡང་དག་པར་ཞུགས་པ: ཡང་དག་པར is 'correctly/properly' (cf. Skt. samprasthita), not 'truly'; 真實 shifts the sense to authenticity. english_academic: 'correctly entered'.

5-6.translation: 世尊說：「須菩提，同樣地，菩薩不住於任何事物而行布施，其福德聚，須菩提，是因為不易衡量的緣故。」

issues.span: 其福德聚，須菩提，是因為不易衡量的緣故
issues.evidence: Tibetan ... བསོད་ནམས་ཀྱི་ཕུང་པོ་ནི། རབ་འབྱོར་ཚད་གཟུང་བར་སླ་བ་མ་ཡིན་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ says the mass of merit is not easy to measure (the final ཕྱིར་རོ closes the 'why' answer; Skt. tasya puṇyaskandhasya na sukaraṃ pramāṇam udgrahītum has no 'because'). The Chinese 是因為...的緣故 leaves the merit mass with no predicate and reads as 'the merit mass is because it is hard to measure', which garbles the statement.
issues.fix: 其福德聚，須菩提，不易衡量

6-7.translation: 有多少無諸相具足，即有多少非虛妄，

issues.span: 有多少無諸相具足，即有多少非虛妄
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'ji tsam du mtshan phun sum tshogs pa med pa de tsam du mi brdzun te' is a correlative 'to whatever extent ... to that extent' (degree), per Chone Drakpa Shedrub 2-23 ('ji tsam du ... bden par med pa de tsam ni mi brdzun'). The Chinese 有多少...有多少 reads as counting quantities of things, and 無諸相具足 is hard to parse.
issues.fix: 在無諸相具足的程度上，即在同等程度上非虛妄，

6-12.translation: 「須菩提，在未來最後五百年，正法徹底壞滅之時，將會出現具足戒、具足功德、具足般若的菩薩摩訶薩。

issues.span: 具足戒、具足功德、具足般若
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'tshul khrims dang ldan pa, yon tan dang ldan pa, shes rab dang ldan pa' = 'possessing ethical discipline / qualities / wisdom' (Skt. guṇavantaḥ śīlavantaḥ prajñāvantaḥ). 具足戒 is the fixed Chinese term for full ordination vows (upasampadā), and 具足 also collides with the locked 諸相具足 (phun sum tshogs pa) in 6-7. The commentary (Chone 2-26) means the three trainings, not ordination.
issues.fix: 具有戒、具有功德、具有般若

6-20.translation: 無眾生想，無壽者想，因為將不會生起人想。

issues.span: 無眾生想，無壽者想，因為將不會生起人想。
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'sems can du 'du shes pa ma yin | srog tu 'du shes pa ma yin | gang zag tu 'du shes 'jug par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro' is a single series; the closing 'phyir ro' answers the 'why?' of 6-19 for the whole series (self, sentient being, life-force, person). The Chinese 因為 attaches only to the last item, so it reads as if the person-perception explains the first two.
issues.fix: 無眾生想，無壽者想，亦不會生起人想，故如此。

6-38.translation: 為什麼呢？因為諸聖人是以無為而區分的。

issues.evidence: Tibetan འཕགས་པའི་གང་ཟག་རྣམས is a locked term (འཕགས་པའི་གང་ཟག -> 聖者); the translation renders it 聖人 instead of the locked 聖者. Meaning is intact (cf. Vasubandhu 2-32, Chone 2-36).
locked termbase rendering not used
issues.fix: use the locked rendering: 聖者

6-46.translation: 世尊說：須菩提，比起有善男子或善女人將此三千大千世界裝滿七寶並給予施物，若有人從此教法之法門中甚至僅受持四句偈，為他人解說並真實開示，從該基礎將產生更多、無數且無量的福德聚。

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་འདི་ལས is the single locked term ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས -> 法門 ("this Dharma discourse/teaching"). The translation renders ཆོས་ separately as 教法 and then adds 法門, doubling the term (教法之法門).

6-47.translation: 為什麼呢？須菩提，因為如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者諸佛的阿耨多羅三藐三菩提，是從此處出生的。

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས་རྣམས is one locked term (-> 正等覺者, plural); the translation renders སངས་རྒྱས་ twice (正等覺者 plus 諸佛), as if two items.

Tibetan 6-47 has only དེ་ཅིའི་ཕྱིར་ཞེ་ན། ... འདི་ལས་བྱུང་སྟེ, ending in the continuative སྟེ; the causal ཕྱིར་རོ comes only in 6-48 (སྐྱེས་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ). The added 因為 in 6-47 creates a double "because" with 6-48 (cf. Kamalasila 3-78, which cites this clause as the reason).

7-28.translation: 世尊，如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者、佛指示我是住於無煩惱者之中最為第一，

issues.evidence: The Tibetan has three epithets: de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas. The glossary locks the whole compound yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas as 正等覺者; the sub-entry sangs rgyas = 佛 is already inside it. Rendering both makes a fourth epithet (佛) that the Tibetan does not have.
bstan (Skt. nirdiṣṭa) here means 'declared / designated' as foremost; 指示 in Chinese means 'to instruct or point out', which is a different act.

7-29.translation: 世尊，雖然我是遠離貪欲的離欲阿羅漢，但世尊，我不作是想：『我是阿羅漢。』

issues.span: 遠離貪欲的離欲阿羅漢
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'dod chags dang bral ba dgra bcom pa = 'an arhat free from desire' (Skt. arhan vītarāgaḥ). The locked 離欲 already renders 'dod chags dang bral ba; 遠離貪欲 renders the same words again, so the phrase says 'free-from-desire' twice.

7-30.translation: 世尊，如果我這樣想：「我得到了阿羅漢位」，如來對我所謂的「善男子須菩提是住於無煩惱者之中的第一，

issues.span: 如來對我所謂的「善男子須菩提是住於無煩惱者之中的第一，
issues.evidence: Tibetan: de bzhin gshegs pas bdag la rigs kyi bu rab 'byor ni nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog yin te = the Tathagata's act of declaring concerning me (Skt. na mam tathagato vyakarisyat ...). The Chinese turns the Tathagata's declaring into a noun phrase ('what the Tathagata so-called regarding me') and leaves an opened quotation that is closed only at the end of 7-31, so the 7-31 clause (which is Subhuti's own reason, lung mi ston lags so) falls inside the Tathagata's quoted words. The 'if I thought ...' clause is left with no verb for the Tathagata. Chone Drakpa Shedrub 2-50 reads it as the Tathagata declaring conventionally that Subhuti is foremost of those abiding without affliction, while not declaring 'abiding' ultimately.
issues.fix: 如來對我宣說：「善男子須菩提是住於無煩惱者之中的第一」，

7-31.translation: 因為無所安住，故不授記為『住於無煩惱者』。」

issues.span: 故不授記為『住於無煩惱者』。」
issues.evidence: Tibetan ci la yang mi gnas pas na nyon mongs pa med par gnas pa zhes lung mi ston lags so: the honorific lags marks this as Subhuti speaking of the Tathagata, who does not declare. The Chinese has no subject for 不授記 and, because of the unclosed quotation in 7-30, the final 」 closes the Tathagata's supposed words, so the speaker is misassigned. English_academic supplies 'the Tathagata does not declare me'.
issues.fix: 由於我無所安住，如來不授記我為『住於無煩惱者』。」

7-73.translation: 須菩提回答說：「世尊，如來所宣說的法任何都不存在。」

issues.span: 如來所宣說的法任何都不存在
issues.evidence: Tibetan དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པས་གང་གསུངས་པའི་ཆོས་དེ་གང་ཡང་མ་མཆིས་ལགས་སོ = 'there is no dharma whatsoever that the Tathagata has spoken' (Sanskrit nāsti sa kaścid dharmo yas tathāgatena bhāṣitaḥ). The Chinese places 任何 after the noun as a floating quantifier ('the dharma spoken by the Tathagata, any, none exists'), which is awkward and could be misparsed; the scope of 'any' over dharma should be explicit.
issues.fix: 如來所宣說的任何法都不存在

8-2.translation: 你認為應以那些大丈夫的三十二相來見如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者、佛嗎？

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས་ is one epithet ('perfectly complete Buddha'; Skt samyaksaṃbuddha), so the series is Tathāgata, arhat, perfectly complete Buddha (three items). The enumeration '正等覺者、佛' makes 佛 a fourth separate epithet.

8-6.translation: 世尊說：「須菩提，比起有男子或女人布施等同恆河沙數的身體，若有人從此教法的法門中，哪怕只受持四句偈並為他人真實宣說，此人以此為基礎，將產生遠為更多的無數、無量福德。」

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ is a single locked term (Dharma discourse) rendered 法門; the translation stacks the separate locked rendering of ཆོས (教法) in front of it as '教法的法門', which reads as 'the Dharma's discourse-teaching' and is not a rendering of the compound.

8-9.translation: 世尊，如來如此詳盡地宣說這部教法的法門，真是稀有！善逝，真是稀有！

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ is a single locked term (Dharma discourse) rendered 法門; the translation stacks the separate locked rendering of ཆོས (教法) in front of it as '教法的法門', which reads as 'the Dharma's discourse-teaching' and is not a rendering of the compound.

8-10.translation: 世尊，自從我生起本智以來，我以前從未聽聞過這部教法的法門。

issues.evidence: Tibetan ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས་ is a single locked term (Dharma discourse) rendered 法門; the translation stacks the separate locked rendering of ཆོས (教法) in front of it as '教法的法門', which reads as 'the Dharma's discourse-teaching' and is not a rendering of the compound.

8-11.translation: 為什麼呢？世尊，對於宣說此經將生起真實想的那些眾生，將具備最極稀有。

issues.span: 對於宣說此經將生起真實想的那些眾生
issues.evidence: Tibetan མདོ་སྡེ་བཤད་པ་འདི་ལ་ is passive/locative: 'when this sūtra is being explained' (Skt bhāṣyamāṇe); the active '宣說此經' lets the reader take the beings as the ones doing the teaching.
issues.fix: 對於此經被宣說時將生起真實想的那些眾生

8-14.translation: 世尊，我思惟並信解這部被宣說的教法的法門，對我來說並不稀有；

8-19.translation: 那是為什麼呢？因為諸佛世尊即是遠離一切想的緣故。

issues.span: 諸佛世尊即是遠離一切想
issues.evidence: Tibetan སངས་རྒྱས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྣམས་ནི་འདུ་ཤེས་ཐམས་ཅད་དང་བྲལ་བ is a plain predicate ('are free of all perceptions'), with no ཉིད; '即是' reads as an identity statement (Buddhas are freedom-from-perception), unlike 8-12/8-18 where དེ་ཉིད justifies 即是.
issues.fix: 諸佛世尊已遠離一切想

8-22.translation: 凡是在這部經被宣說時不驚恐、不害怕、不極度畏懼的眾生，將具備極其稀有之特質。

8-31.translation: 須菩提，我憶念在過去世中，我於五百世中成為名為忍辱仙人的仙人，即使在那時，我也未生起我想，

issues.evidence: Tibetan བཟོད་པ་སྨྲ་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་དྲང་སྲོང་དུ་གྱུར་པ means 'became the sage (དྲང་སྲོང) called Kṣāntivādin'. The locked rendering 忍辱仙人 already contains 仙人, so 名為忍辱仙人的仙人 repeats 仙人 tautologically; meaning is intact.

11-13.translation: 世尊告言：「須菩提！固然應當攝受，但不應顛倒攝受，」

issues.evidence: Tibetan ལོག་པར་མི་བཟུང་ means 'one should not take hold wrongly/in a wrong way' (cf. Kamalaśīla 3-237: ལོག་པར་འཛིན་པ་ནི་ལམ་ལོག་པར་འཛིན་པ, grasping in a wrong way). 顛倒 is the standard rendering of ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག (viparyāsa), a different term, and adds a technical nuance; English academic has 'wrongly'.

11-17.translation: 因此，稱之為如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者、佛。

issues.evidence: The Tibetan ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས is a single epithet (perfectly complete Buddha), already fully rendered by the locked 正等覺者; appending a separate 佛 produces four epithets (如來、阿羅漢、正等覺者、佛) where the Tibetan has three (cf. Sanskrit tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddha).

13-3.translation: 名為聖《能斷金剛般若波羅蜜》的大乘經圓滿。

issues.span: 名為聖《能斷金剛般若波羅蜜》的大乘經
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'འཕགས་པ་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ་རྡོ་རྗེ་གཅོད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ' (Skt. ārya-vajracchedikā ... prajñāpāramitā): 'noble' (འཕགས་པ, locked 聖) qualifies the sūtra/title as a whole, but placing 聖 directly before the title in 名為聖《…》 makes it read as an odd, unattached word or part of the title.
issues.fix: 名為《能斷金剛般若波羅蜜》的聖大乘經圓滿
